paragraphs: scGPT and scVI Citation-Use Review — Consolidated Results
Machine outcomes and two-reviewer primary-use validation
This document brings the latest frozen scGPT and scVI citation-use results into one place. Counts are at the citing-study-record level unless physical-paper deduplication is stated.
Primary-use labels are mutually exclusive: Apply to biological data; Extend or develop; Benchmark or evaluate; Mention only; and Other executed use.
Coverage incomplete, citation not located, and machine unresolved or no final are evidence or process states. They are not evidence that the method was not used.
Every percentage states its denominator. Machine-composition percentages use classified records only; validation metrics use the human-reviewed subset.

565: 354 full text unavailable; 200 rights not approved; 11 parse/coverage/context gate
The scVI rescue pass re-reviewed 122 records and produced 103 newly classified results relative to its v3 base. The harmonized scVI aggregate therefore contains 951 classified records.

Both studies used two blinded human reviewers followed by a consensus step. Scoring treats the human consensus primary-use label as the reference standard and requires one primary label per scored paper.

For scGPT, 40 classification papers from a 50-paper formal sample were scored; 10 additional papers audited evidence and abstention states. Physical-paper deduplication gives a 400-study classified estimand and 719 eligible physical papers.
For scVI, the same 50/40 structure was used. After the rescue update, 39 of the original 40 classification papers remain machine-classified; HV-032 is now a no-final abstention.

Per-class values below are unweighted one-vs-rest hard-label results. They are operating points, not full precision–recall curves.
The category distributions describe two different citing corpora. Differences should not be interpreted as causal evidence that one method penetrated routine biological discovery more deeply.
The scGPT design-weighted primary-use accuracy is 88.42% for its original 400-study physically deduplicated classified frame. Its unweighted accuracy is shown for direct transparency.

The previous scVI sampling weights targeted an older 881-paper classified frame and are not valid for the updated 951-paper aggregate because the 103 newly classified papers had zero probability of entering the old sample.
The current scVI validation is therefore descriptive. A population estimate for all 951 classified records requires a supplementary human sample from the newly classified set.
OTHER_EXECUTED_USE is not included in the class-specific validation table because the audited classification subsets contain no estimable human-positive class support.

Machine outputs: the scGPT final report summary (report fingerprint e5cc7b6e…1197a) and the scVI harmonized manifest plus review-record JSONL (SHA-256 74618813…cf52). Human validation: the frozen two-reviewer consensus and primary-use scoring artifacts for each method. For scVI, the original 50-paper crosswalk was rejoined to the latest harmonized aggregate before recalculation.
